# thetalake_retention_library (Resource)

The retention library resource allows for the creation and management of retention libraries within Theta Lake.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thetalake_retention_library" "example" {
  name               = "Example Retention Library"
  storage_account_id = 1
  description        = "Used to store data for the compliance environment"
  external_id        = "ext-001"

  retention_period_enabled = true
  retention_period_days    = 365
  retain_in_review         = true

  sec_compliant_storage_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the retention library
- `storage_account_id` (Number) The storage account ID to associate with this retention library

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the retention library
- `external_id` (String) An external identifier for the retention library
- `retain_in_review` (Boolean) Indicates if the retention library should be retained while review is open
- `retention_period_days` (Number) Retention period in days
- `retention_period_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if a retention period policy is currently enabled
- `sec_compliant_storage_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if the storage has SEC Rule 17a-4 compliance enabled

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The created timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `datum_count` (Number) The number of datums stored in the retention library
- `datum_size` (Number) The total size of all the datums in the retention library
- `delete_on_expiration` (Boolean) Denotes if this retention library should delete records associated with it when they expire
- `display_name` (String) The retention library display name including the region
- `id` (Number) The retention library ID
- `legal_hold_count` (Number) The number of datums in legal hold in this retention library
- `retention_summary_text` (String) Summary description of the retention policy
- `sec_compliant_storage_confirmed` (Boolean) Indicates if the SEC Rule 17a-4 compliance has been confirmed
- `swrv_rule_count` (Number) Smart workflow review (SWRV) rules currently applied to this retention library
- `updated_at` (String) The updated timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
